themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, execute workflows, and interact with systems or tools to gather information.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, reviewing, and understanding code.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic real users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting job roles, hiring, skills requirements, and overall employment landscapes.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discusses AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in data collection, analysis, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications for automating or enhancing the process of testing product usability and user experience.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and insights.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Reviews and compares different AI tools and platforms available for research, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to inform, generate, or accelerate the design process, from ideation to high-fidelity prototyping.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, capabilities, risks, and user interactions associated with AI chatbots.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
